candidates.tagline: Tombstone put candy corn on pizza — they named it 'The Pizza Nobody Asked For'
candidates.story: For Halloween 2026, Tombstone launched a $1.31 kit where you add candy corn to frozen pepperoni pizza — a product they marketed under the official name 'The Pizza Nobody Asked For,' with three limited online drops throughout October.
candidates.why_funny: Tombstone essentially published its own one-star review as the product title and sold it anyway.
candidates.alt: Pepperoni pizza topped with candy corn kernels on a dark surface, Tombstone's 2026 Halloween pizza kit alongside the box packaging

candidates.tagline: Russia's robot tank needed a human driver — then still got stuck in a ditch
candidates.story: During Russia's Tsentr-2026 military exercise on October 3, the Shturm autonomous combat tank repeatedly lost its radio link with its control vehicle, so organisers put a human driver inside for the Putin demonstration — the opposite of the tank's entire purpose — whereupon it immediately became stuck nose-down in a muddy ditch.
candidates.why_funny: Russia's answer to 'how do we field a tank without risking a soldier?' produced a vehicle that can't navigate a dirt track even with a human inside it.
candidates.alt: Russia's Shturm robotic tank tilted nose-forward into a muddy ditch during the Tsentr-2026 military exercise, its front hull and tracks partially submerged in soft ground
candidates.credit: Open source footage via United24 Media
